experiment.title: SCE 1.8 Preventive Probe: Validate IAM Deny Policy Blocks IMDS Enumeration and Downgrade
experiment.description: Security Chaos Engineering experiment validating that an explicit IAM deny policy (simulating an SCP preventive control) successfully blocks attack steps 1.2 (ec2:DescribeInstances for IMDS enumeration - T1580) and 1.7 (ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions for IMDS downgrade to IMDSv1 and hop limit increase - T1562.001). The experiment provisions a banking-tier EC2 instance with IMDSv2 enforced and a restricted IAM role with deny policy, then attempts both attack steps using the restricted role and verifies that both are denied and IMDS configuration remains intact.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Preventive IAM deny policy blocks IMDS reconnaissance and downgrade attempts

probes.name: Verify both ec2:DescribeInstances and ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions are denied and IMDS remains IMDSv2-enforced with hop-limit 1
